blocks.text: Germany's largest car maker reported third quarter losses of €5.8 billion as its major financial struggles continue. And Chancellor Friedrich Merz concludes his tour of Asia with a visit to South Korea. DW has more.

blocks.caption: VW has struggled with the transition to electric vehicles [FILE: February 2025]Image: Carmen Jaspersen/REUTERS

items: Volkswagen (VW) posts 3rd quarter losses of €5.8 billion ($6.46 bln)
VW has been struggling to keep pace with competition from China and to transition to electric vehicles
Chancellor Friedrich Merz is in South Korea at the end of his Asia tour
